L85-106 the `<DataTable<IngestXRayFieldStat> ... />` render ported 1:1: tableId='admin:xray-fields', name='xray-fields', columns, data={sorted}, keyExtractor={row=>row.field}, sortKey, sortDir, onSort, emptyMessage = loading ? t('admin.xray.fields.loading','Loading\u2026') : t('admin.xray.fields.empty','No samples in this window. Try widening the window or confirm the vehicle is publishing.'), pagination={{defaultPageSize:50, pageSizeOptions:[25,50,100]}}, mobileColumns={['field','sample_count','last_seen_at']}. The native DataTable wraps in a GlassPanel, renders sortable headers (a \u25B2/\u25BC indicator on the active sort column reflecting sortDir, \u2195 otherwise; tapping calls onSort), the empty/loading message via testID admin:xray-fields-empty, and a pager footer honouring defaultPageSize 50 + selectable pageSizeOptions [25,50,100] (prev/next + 'page / pages' info, page resets to 1 on size change). L107 closing brace preserved.

Parity decisions: `mobileColumns` + per-column `visibleOnMobile` are ported verbatim as table metadata; on the single-column native surface the full four-column table renders (consistent with the existing native DataTable ports in SignalQueryControls/HttpStatusTool and preserving the Kind-badge visual intent rather than hiding it). The web Tooltip on TimeStamp (hover-only) and the web DataTable's column-visibility/resize/persistence machinery are not user-facing on native and are intentionally not reproduced (only the props this component actually passes are implemented). No DOM-only modules, browser HTML, window/document, react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components/ui imports appear in the native output — only React (useCallback/useMemo/useState), react-native primitives (Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the native AppText + GlassPanel, the theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography), and the native useIngestXRay hook.

A focused __tests__/XRayFieldsTable.test.tsx (react-test-renderer, the repo convention) exercises: all four headers render with their English defaults; one row per field renders with fmtInt grouping (12345 -> '12,345'), formatValueKind labels (6->float64, 10->location, 1->string) and the relative TimeStamp body ('just now'); default sample_count-descending order; tapping the field header sorts desc (reverse-alphabetical) then toggles asc (alphabetical); tapping the sample_count header flips to ascending; the loading message ('Loading\u2026') and the empty-window message; and pagination (60 rows -> '1 / 2' at default size 50, next page shows the remaining 10, switching to page size 25 re-clamps to '1 / 3').
